children: Pyxis Oncology reported a 36% confirmed objective response rate and 6.2‑month median PFS for MICVO in 2L+ recurrent/metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
Phase 1 monotherapy (5.4 mg/kg dose cap) efficacy-evaluable N=33: 36% cORR (12/33) and 94% DCR (31/33).
Median PFS 6.2 months (95% CI 4.8–8.8); 12‑month OS probability 79% (95% CI 58.1–90.3); median OS not reached.
Responses were rapid/deep: 75% of responders by first six‑week scan; 83% of responders had >50% tumor reduction.
No new safety signals; tolerability consistent with auristatin‑payload ADCs—Grade ≥3 TRAEs in 54.3%, treatment‑related deaths 0.
Company plans pivotal Phase 3 Headliner trial in mid‑2027 and will align on Ph3 dose after Project Optimus/FDA feedback in Q1 2027.
